format: The "where" sentence a notification carries. kind=where: input {now, dish, newton, places [{key, area}], hours {place: DiningHallHours}, grab? {place: window}, days {isoDate: {place: {meal: [dish names]}}}} -> expected {groups, sentences}. now is an absolute instant (ISO 8601 with offset), read as Eastern wall time. groups is wherePlan (app/lib/core/m2/where.dart) as WhereGroup.toJson, soonest first; sentences[k] is whenText(groups[k], groups[k-1]). newton is always false: the server never answers for the Charles River places (area 4). The source is Dart: regenerate with `cd app && dart run tool/where_vectors.dart`; never hand-edit expected.
